spoken_summary: Donald Trump announces that he has had a "very productive meeting" with the NYC Mayor-elect, Zohran Mamdani. He congratulates Mamdani on his electoral victory, stating he ran an "incredible race." Trump says they have common ground on issues like housing and lowering prices for food and oil. He claims his actions are good for New York, citing a Walmart report that Thanksgiving costs are down 25% from the previous year. He concludes by saying there is "no difference in party" and that his administration will help the new mayor have a "strong and very safe New York."
